She was my 2nd girlfriend; I was 15 and meeting her hit me like (as cheesy as this sounds) an atom bomb; I'd already been through all the romantic/sexual firsts by that point but with her it kind of seemed like an erasure of the previous firsts because this time I cared.

after a couple of years she left me and this of course tore me apart. A few months later she started phoning me asking me to be with her again; I still wasn't over her but I told her I couldn't be with her - this was because I knew that if it ever ended again I couldn't go through what I'd been going through again; saying "no" nearly killed me (figuratively speaking)

15 years on, She is married now and lives an ocean away - in the US (we're friends on facebook) and I am in a reasonably popular band here in the UK, I also work as an electronics engineer - I find that my days are filled up with more and more projects to escape what I can never have with her. it is quite a miserable existence and because I can't openly talk about with people due to my public standing (and fear that it will get back to her) I just have no way of working through it and I doubt that I ever could.

who she was and still appears to be absolutely floored me - if I believed in that soulmate crap, I would definitely say she was mine. we used to listen to "without you I'm nothing" by Placebo together - it seems quite fitting for me now.
